note: axHub in the control registry (build full-api-cli-control-of-everything-plus-an-offli, s9): the app and its pages (deep links #/<route>, a URL handoff), the hub's connections and tools through the provider bridge (provider:axhub/catalog, provider:axhub/call: the console's own hub token, reads at once, changes sent once with a reason and approved by Brett on axHub), the look kept on axHub (control@1 tokens) and the areas axHub has not built yet as gaps with the hub's own reason. Hostinger, Coolify and VPS are providers/<name>/registry.json beside this file. Merged by id.

entries.label: axHub connections
entries.description: Every service connected to axHub and its tools (service.tool). catalog lists them from the live hub; call runs one with arguments: a read runs at once, anything else goes to axHub once with a reason and waits for Brett's approval there. The provider bridge (server/registry_providers.py) that Hostinger, Coolify and VPS entries run through.

entries.label: axHub sync
entries.description: lib-hubsync: an app's settings kept on axHub, the same on every device (Settings → Plugins → axHub sync in each app). The values themselves are the apps' settings, registered on their own entries (the console's look: console-web/display/tokens.*).

gaps.why: sync start, stop and refresh run inside each app's window (lib-hubsync), not on a server the console can call
gaps.plan: an app command channel (as for Molly)

entries.label: axHub look
entries.description: The look every app reads from axHub (developer.hub): the same tokens as the console's display entries, written through control@1 (stored on axHub).
